Mockup, nothing is live yet

Bapa's stories from baps.org, in English

Each day baps.org's Daily Satsang page tells a short Gujarati story about Bapa with its own date and place. These are now translated into English and shown on the exact day they happened. A small gold word beside each story switches it to the original Gujarati and back, as you asked. The pictures are the real website with the new part drawn in (dashed gold line). Example day: Sarangpur, 16 March 2010.

1. Today

Under the year, in English

The story sits under that year's heading on Today, with a quiet "English translation" note under it. No source line is shown on the website.

2. The switch

Tap ગુજરાતી to read the original

On the left in English, on the right after tapping the small gold word. Tap "English" to go back. If the whole site is set to Gujarati, the stories open in Gujarati.

3. Calendar

On the clicked day, above the photos

4. Search

The same stories in Search

The Search part is in its own mockup: open the Search mockup. Searching a word like "greatness" brings up the stories, in English with the same Gujarati switch.

What is ready
  1. 224 stories translated so far, from 2007 to 2010, all Pramukh Swami Maharaj. More get translated as the reading of baps.org carries on each evening.
  2. 91 stories have no date of their own, so they cannot go on a day. They wait for now.
  3. The database keeps everything: Gujarati, English, date, place and the baps.org link.
